title: SuperframeConfig documentation contradicts epoch-relative implementation
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs SuperframeConfig::superframe_id documents the GCP absolute unix/duration formula, but the type explicitly stores 'Unix timestamp of superframe 0 start' and implements saturating (timestamp-epoch)/duration. This conflates the canonical global helper with an epoch-relative schedule and invites using the wrong claim freshness domain. Correct the method documentation to state its epoch-relative semantics and point callers needing canonical GCP IDs to superframe_id_from_timestamp.
